description: Generated by scripts/vendor.mjs from mapping.json and Google's icon sets; do not edit by hand. 'sources' are the ZIP files downloaded from the links on https://cloud.google.com/icons, 'files' the vendored SVG files (raw: as Google ships them; vendored: after the mechanical transforms, which never change artwork), 'icons' maps each icon key whose artwork is vendored to its file. Own drawings are not vendored (see mapping.json and own/).
